remarks: Discover care-free living in this well maintained 3-bedroom, 2-bathroom home located in a quiet and desirable Stamford neighborhood. This residence has the perfect blend of convenience and tranquility, with easy access to all amenities while being nestled in a peaceful setting. The open floor plan seamlessly connects the living spaces, creating an ideal environment for both relaxation and entertaining. The large chef's kitchen is a culinary delight, featuring high-end appliances, generous counter space, and abundant cabinetry. Enjoy cozy evenings by the fire with two fireplaces that add warmth and charm to the home. The spacious bedrooms are filled with natural light. Step outside to enjoy the stunning gardens that surround the property, offering a picturesque backdrop year-round. Relax on the covered porch, perfect for morning coffee or evening gatherings. The detached 2-car garage provides ample parking and additional storage. This home is a true gem, convenience, comfort, and beauty. Don't miss this opportunity to live in a quiet neighborhood. Welcome home!
